name: tablespec
description: UMF table-schema workflows: bootstrap UMF from Spark/Databricks tables, profile, validate, generate sample data and Spark/LDP/dbt pipeline artifacts.

interface.longDescription: tablespec packages UMF-based table-schema tooling for bootstrapping, profiling, validating, and generating pipeline artifacts in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use the tablespec skill to bootstrap UMF specs from Databricks tables.
